correctness.rationale: In polar variables q=u²+v², the reduced motion is canonical for H/2 with z'=A−q, q'=(2z−1)q and θ'=β. H is conserved and divergence vanishes in physical coordinates. Each positive regular level inside Ω is a compact oval times the angle circle; the only critical level there is the central circle at H=1/16. This gives both-time invariance and the winding classification, with the rational tori a countable union of null surfaces. The two z branches give P=2∫dz/√(A²−h); factoring around z=1/2 gives 4 K(m)/√(1/4+√h), with strict decrease and limit 2π√2 at the center. DLMF §19.12.1 in modulus convention gives K(m)=log(4/√(1−m))+o(1) in the record's parameter convention; 1−m∼8√h and the prefactor is 8+O(√h), so P=2 log(4/h)+o(1), with the correct additive constant. The physical Jacobian after angle integration is π dq dz and V(0)=π/3. Independently, layer-cake integration of A−√((A²−h)_+) shows V(0)−V(h)=(π/2)∫_0^h P(s)ds, without differentiating a moving endpoint. Thus the normalized lost volume is 3h(log(4/h)+1)+o(h). Inverting the monotone period gives h_R=4e^(−πR/β)(1+o(1)), establishing the displayed tail constant 12π/β.
